releaseNotes: Brukkarg War: five-day launch event, enemy bases, copied-yard finale and Spurtz rewards.
New friends, construction help, relocation and accepted-friend gifts.
PvP level limits, vengeance, consistent combat timing and alliance world rules. Resource outposts remain available to high-level players.
Planner, rendering and save fixes; approved native Shiny shop redesign.
Krallen 250m quota/outpost loot, D.A.V.E. benefits and separate logins preserved.
Close the game and choose Update game. Launcher 0.4.5 is unchanged; no reinstall needed.
